BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning surcharge for electricity used to charge vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a surcharge for electricity used to charge vehicles; and adding a new section to chapter 19.29A RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 19.29A RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) An electric utility shall impose a surcharge of three cents per kilowatt-hour of electricity used to charge a vehicle at each electric vehicle charging station served by the electric utility.

(2) By January 1, 2021, each electric utility shall examine the technological feasibility of imposing a surcharge on electricity used to charge vehicles at residences within the service area of the electric utility.
(3) For the purposes of this section:
(a) "Electric vehicle charging station" has the same meaning as defined under RCW 46.08.185.
(b) "Vehicle" has the same meaning as defined under RCW 46.04.670.
